notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update!
notes.notes:
The first version of Zombie Vegas Demo has "some" defects but I fixed most of them in the update. 

This happened because I prepared another demo for the festival in priority. You can check it too :)

The Witchmade Shop

Now Zombie Vegas Demo is properly playable. I fixed localization and interface issues, sound, add some atmosphere elements, and so on.

And I'm thinking about how to expand the game. I keep struggling with the idea of adding some survival mechanics. If you have any feedback, I'd love to get it! ːcozyhitman2ː
